args.summary: Built stdlib-only compress.py with the requested compression/decompression CLI. It stores inferred numeric sequences and periodic phrases, arithmetic-codes exceptions, and falls back to bzip2 for unstructured inputs. The 313,972-byte corpus compresses to 2,905 bytes (99.0748% reduction), beating default zlib’s 35,399 bytes. CLI restoration is byte-identical; edge cases and 30,000 randomized arithmetic symbols also passed round-trip checks. Registered python3 assay.py, which ran in about 0.48 seconds and produced identical scores across three validation runs.
